op: triangle multiplicative update (outgoing | incoming): pre-LayerNorm pair tensor z [B,N,N,c_z] (+ pair mask [B,N,N]) -> LN_in -> a,b = mask * sigmoid(z W_ag) * (z W_ap), ... -> X[i,j,:] = sum_k a[i,k,:] b[j,k,:] (outgoing) | sum_k a[k,i,:] b[k,j,:] (incoming) -> sigmoid(z W_og) * (LN_out(X) W_o) (+ z when residual)
key_grammar: <cc>|<precision>|C<c_z>|H<c_hidden>|N<=<tokens>|<dir>|<pass>  precision: bf16 (z bf16 under bf16 autocast) | f32z_bf16 (z fp32 under bf16 autocast: the fp32-residency trunks) | fp32 (TF32 off) | tf32 (fp32, TF32 on); dir: out | in | outin (the ESM-family pair block: both updates with residual in one measured unit); pass: fwd | fwdbwd (grad wrt the pair tensor). select() serves the smallest measured size >= n_tokens of the (cc, precision, C, H, dir, pass) family, else its largest size flagged beyond_measured; a (dir=out|in) query falls to the outin family when only that was measured for the pass.

evidence.cells: every row of a cell timed in one process per software stack: CUDA events, 2 warm-up + 5 interleaved rounds x 3 calls per arm, medians (3600 timed arms; plus the cc 8.0 c_z 384 arms of the TM-K3 exact row and the stock op, 2 warm-up + 5 timed interleaved); development-GPU measurements that choose rows, not acceptance records
evidence.method: CUDA events, 2 warm-up + 5 interleaved rounds x 3 calls per arm, all arms of a cell in one process; x_stock = stock ms / row ms in the same process (stock = the image's cuequivariance op, else the torch module math)
evidence.race_v3: cells.<key>.race_v3.<stack> = the same-box race on that stack (round 3): H100 passes ptx2c r6 (torch 2.13 / cuequivariance 0.11 image), bz2 r4 (2.12), of3 r4 (2.10), odde r3 (2.7.1 / triton 3.3), ef2fa r3 (2.13, no cuequivariance) and the A100 legs ptx2c / bz2 / of3 (cc 8.0: 2.13 / 2.12 / 2.10 images); every carried row + the ESM-family rows (esm_v5_fwd with its swept 128- / 64-wide launch cells, esm_v61, esm_v5_fwd:f32in) + the re-tiled sub-package (rows esm_shapes | esm_shapes:f32in as a package arm) + the stock op in ONE process per (cell, stack): 8 ABBA bursts x 5 calls, medians + IQR, steady-state per-call peak deltas.  Its arms are THE run kept in ms / x_stock / class for that stack; every other number on that stack sits in cells.<key>.extra_runs with its origin; residual-form, direct-call and tier-word-at-race-sha arms sit in cells.<key>.extra.  The earlier round's blocks (race_v1, 0.5.50.2..0.5.57.1: same boxes and images, older core, H100 only) are superseded.
evidence.shapes_v1: cells.<key>.shapes_v1.<stack> = the re-tiled sub-package's own same-box race (its served arm + v4 / tmk3 / bz2 / tx / esm_v5_fwd where they admit + the stock op, one process, 2 ABBA rounds x 10 calls, absolute peaks) on the 2.13 H100 / A100 images and the triton-3.3 H100 images: THE kept run where no race_v3 run covers the (cell, stack); where the kept race_v3 run lacks the sub-package arm, the sub-package row displaces that run's fast row only with a >= 5 %-beyond-IQR win over it inside the sub-package's own run; where the kept race_v3 run has the sub-package arm the block is informational (absolute peaks).
evidence.default_rule_applied: DEFAULT-FLIP rule: on every (cell, stack) the incumbent is the cell's PRE-RACE default (fast_per_stack, else the cell-level word); the kept run moves the tier word only when its fastest fast-tier arm beats that incumbent by >= 5 % with non-overlapping IQRs in the same process; parity keeps the incumbent; an incumbent the kept run did not time keeps the word and the stack is listed in cells.<key>.pending_race.  STANDING-WORD rule: the word the table carried before this fold (what tier-word kits inherit today) is a co-incumbent -- it moves only on same-box evidence against IT in one process (beaten beyond noise; a lower steady-state peak for big; the exact rule), or because it is refused by name on that stack, or because it never beat the pre-race incumbent there (WITHDRAWN), or under the f32z memoised-cast rule; a standing word the kept run did not time holds and pending_race says 'standing: ...' naming the challenger.  exact = the incumbent exact row if bitwise and at x_stock >= 1.00 in the kept run, else the fastest such row, else the stock op of the stack (a byte-tested row at >= parity displaces a stock-row word: the stock rows are the rule's fallback, not incumbents); big = lowest steady-state peak (within 3 % or 8 MiB) then speed, incumbents kept on parity.  Every kept run records its per-tier decision in <run>.decided.<tier> = {row, pre, tip, vs_pre, vs_tip}.  cells.<key>.contested names the one cell family where in-model evidence overrides the op-level number.

of3_form.package: opt_core.kernels.trimul.of3_form (core-written: the OpenFold-family TriangleMultiplicativeUpdate INFERENCE statement issued whole-tensor -- LN_in once, the four projections and the output gate as cuBLAS GEMMs on it, sigmoid then product then mask in place, the contraction as upstream's einsum one 256-column block at a time (upstream's problem shapes and operand strides), LN_out, output projection, gate product; LayerNorms on the core's exactln row (kernels.ln, ATen's kernel bit for bit) where it admits, else ATen's; no rotating z-cache, no per-block recompute, no host loop but the contraction's)
of3_form.exact_vs: the OpenFold-family engine MODULE (openfold3 0.4.1 TriangleMultiplicativeUpdate._inference_forward = its forward without the cuequivariance flag: the template pair stack's statement on every line; the trunk's when the flag is off) -- bitwise on the measured stack at c 64 (400 / 800 / 1200 tokens, both directions, bf16 as the engine runs it, and the fp32 / tf32 and fp32-resident-under-bf16-autocast states of the same tensors) and at c 128 in those states; NOT the cuequivariance op (tolerance class there: LayerNorm statistics and gate roundings differ -- max abs 0.5-1.0 at the template stack's bf16 pair magnitudes, rel-rms vs fp64 0.0029-0.0031 where the library's is 0.0025-0.0026)
of3_form.residual: optional (z + update in z's dtype, the value upstream's in-place add produces)
of3_form.boundary: pre-LN z [N,N,c] or [B,N,N,c] (+mask [B,N,N] of any float dtype, multiplied into the plane in place as upstream) -> update in the GEMM dtype (bf16 for bf16 z or under bf16 autocast, else z's) or z + update; c_hidden read off w_ap; the ten canonical weights as the module holds them (cast per OpenFold's LayerNorm / Linear dtype rules, casts memoised per module); no biases (refused by name at the face like every fused row)

cc: >=8.0 (9.0 measured; the statements are ATen / cuBLAS calls and run on any part -- unmeasured parts keep the row selectable by word, the kit's first-call proof decides)

refusals: backward (grad required at the serving call) -> torch_math
of3_form.numerics: EXACT by measurement, not by construction: cuBLAS picks its kernel per problem shape, so the whole-tensor projections (reduction over c_z) and the row-wise LayerNorms reproduce upstream's per-block calls bit for bit on the measured stack; the contraction is issued in upstream's own 256-column blocks. A kit binds it by ROW WORD for the classes whose statement is the module and keeps its first-call proof (torch.equal against the module on the block's first call per class).

af3t_form.boundary: z [N,N,c] or [B,N,N,c] bf16 | fp32 (fp32 under bf16 autocast: fp32 LayerNorm, bf16 GEMMs -- the engine's confidence-head residency); mask None | [N,N] / [B,N,N] any float dtype; the ten canonical weights without biases as the engine kit's adapter maps them (even / odd channels of the [2c,c] projection and gate; incoming swaps a/b)

af3t_form.launch: per direction: 2 LayerNorm launches, 4 GEMMs (2c-wide projection, 2c-wide gate, output projection, output gate), 1 batched GEMM over c, 2 fused gate kernels, 1 tiled transpose (hm_fused); no host loop; first call compiles three small Triton kernels (~1 s once per process)

default_rule: word=<row name> serves exactly that row with its own launch cell for the device (what a kit binding that row today already runs, byte for byte); word in {fast, exact, big} is OPT-IN: the cell's measured winner of that tier on the caller's stack (fast_per_stack / exact_per_stack / big_per_stack, else the reference stack's), prefer=(row, ...) narrows the tier to the caller's carried rows in its order of preference; a row that cannot engage refuses BY NAME (Refusal.kind) naming its fallback row -- never silent, never a different row's bytes. DEFAULT-FLIP RULE (round 3 on): see evidence.default_rule_applied -- a re-race moves a tier word only on a >= 5 % beyond-noise same-box win over the pre-race incumbent.
exact_rule: an exact-class row is a cell's exact value only where it measured bitwise-identical to the stock op AND speed >= x1.00 vs the stock op on that stack (exact_parity_flag marks x inside 0.97..1.03); below x1.00 the exact value is the named stock row

numerics_classes.source: the triangle-multiplication numerics baseline of this release (H100, race regime and seeds; fp64 references for bf16 forms, fp64-of-fp32 for fp32 forms; worst case over N 400-2048 x out / in x two masks) + the class column of every kept run in this table; per cell the bf16 word is refined from the measured rel-RMS vs the cuequivariance op on the stacks that have it (<= 1.5e-3 -> A, else B); f32z cells take their bf16 sibling's measured word (same compute path)
numerics_classes.rule: the tier words do not read this column (speed decides fast / big, byte identity decides exact); it is the statement a kit's identity gate needs when it binds a word: a class B row is NOT interchangeable with a class A row inside a gate sealed on class A outputs without a re-seal, and a bf16 residual sum is not an fp32 one

first_call.what: FIRST-CALL host cost per row: one FRESH process per (row or tier word, dtype, c, N 400, outgoing, residual on); cold = an empty TRITON_CACHE_DIR, warm = the same directory on the next process; <state>_s = host wall of the first call (imports, the package's warm probe, Triton compiling the cell's one configuration, the launch); second_call_s = the call right after; steady_ms = per call after three more calls; triton_cache_files = files the process left in the cache dir (0 = nothing compiled: a prebuilt binary or plain torch). Stack H100:2.13.0+cu130/3.7.1/cueq0.11.1 (cc 9.0), core 0.5.58.0 (records) / 0.5.62.1 (kit composition). No row tunes or builds at run time: the seconds are library imports (cuequivariance rows: that library's import ~4-5 s warm) plus Triton's per-process JIT of the ONE config the cell names (disk-cached: cold - warm).
first_call.bound: every row <= 10.2 s cold and <= 5.4 s warm; the fused Triton rows 2.6-5.7 s cold / 1.0-1.7 s warm; tx_sm90a (prebuilt .so) 0.63 s; torch_math 0.4 s
first_call.stack_chunk_hazard: CPython 3.11/3.12 map+unmap a 16 KiB frame chunk per Python call when the stack top sits at a chunk boundary; a syscall-heavy container runtime makes that 37-62 us per call (0.21 us elsewhere), so a Python-heavy one-off (cuequivariance_ops_torch 0.11's 1.57 M-iteration import-time table; a Triton front end) costs 60 s instead of 1.4 s from an unlucky call depth. The face runs every class's first call and every library import through _pystack.padded_call (a 512 KiB chunk for the whole call tree) and, from 0.5.62.1, imports the stack's cuequivariance_torch at the first engagement of any row on both faces (stock_preload_once: padded, once per process, ~1.4 s) so a model's later lazy import of it is a dictionary lookup; preload() does the same at install for kits that prefer it there.

c256_fwd_h100_t211.why: in-model, same image (torch 2.11.0+cu128 / triton 3.6.0 / cuequivariance 0.10.0, H100), the engine's no-save forward call inside its fwd+bwd design step: 'Synthetic kernel numbers (random block weights, scale-4 pair, unmasked; CUDA-event median 2x10): @800 out/in esm_v61 2.087/2.096 ms, esm_v5_fwd 2.412/2.432, v4 2.556/2.588, kit ef2_fused fwd 2.663/2.681; @431 esm_v61 0.722/0.734, v4 0.853/0.844, ef2_fused 0.848/0.831.' and 'Verdict: esm_v61 faster than v4 (kernel 2.55 → 2.11 ms/dir @800; det-0 ABBA step fast 1519.6 → 1491.9, big 1522.4 → 1494.6 ms @n800@25, n=28 each; whole design fast@800 1.532 → 1.503 s/step, big 1.502; peak unchanged), identity inside the band (det 1 n800@25 fast/big ok, grad cos 0.999809 vs v4-bound 0.999671; cd45@25 inert+bitwise; exact structural n/a)' -- esm_v61 x1.22 / x1.23 over v4 per direction at 800 tokens, x1.18 / x1.15 at 431; big = the same rows (its big is fast minus a graph pool; peak unchanged, so speed decides inside the peak band).  The op-level race corroborates on the two other tx-less H100 columns (2.12 / 2.10: esm_v61 x1.15-1.19 over v4 at 400-1200 tokens, race round 3).  No same-box number of this table's harness exists on this column for esm_v61 (v4 / tmk3_exact / cueq / torch_math were timed there before the race); the engine's numbers are the record.

form_rule: Kits bind TIER words.  select(word='exact') with no form serves the stock library op's exact tier (tmk3_exact / tx_sm90a_exact / ef2_cueq_tiles / cueq / torch_math by the cells) -- unchanged.  select(word='exact', form=F) (also spelt word='exact+F') serves forms[F].row where form_cells has '<cc>|<precision>|C|H|N<=size|<dir>|<pass>+F' for the smallest measured size >= n_tokens (the shapes where that row measured BITWISE to the engine MODULE whose statement F names, per stack), else Refusal('form:F(no proven cell at ...)') by name -> the kit keeps its module.  A stack the form cell did not measure is served with reason 'stack unmeasured' (the kit's first-call proof holds it per process).  Form cells never enter the no-form resolution; fast / big ignore form (tolerance class: one statement family).

form_vouch_rule: VOUCH TABLE (0.5.76.0+; classes from 0.5.78.0). `select(word='exact', form=F)` -- and the module-exact rows by name -- serve ONLY where form_cells['<cell>+F'].stacks[<caller's stack word>].vouched admits the exact token count: `N` = explicit sizes (the in_form captures: 400 / 800 / 1200), `N_class` = a LIST of classes {mod, rem, min, max[, except][, config], measured}, first match wins, each measured DENSELY offline (every member size compared to the engine module in both directions); a class naming `config` serves THAT layout at that N (of3_module: N % 16 == 0 -> the cell's fast layout hm_fused / hm_view, every other N in [16, 1200] -> `replica` = the module's own per-block call sequence; af3t_module: N % 8 == 0 -> hm_fused, every other N in [2, 1200] -> `upstream` = the module's own calls). Everything else -- another stack, N outside every class, another precision / width -- is refused BY NAME `form_vouch_not_recorded(shape=<cc|prec|C|H|N|dir>, stack=<word>)` toward the stock row (the caller keeps its module). No bucket, no neighbouring size, no in-process first-call proof licenses a shape. Why classes and not buckets: the OpenFold-family module's blocked inference path and the same statements issued whole-tensor pick different cuBLAS kernels by problem shape -- bitwise at every multiple of 16, not at most N = 8 (mod 16) or even N not divisible by 4, and the transposed-problem layouts additionally not at most odd N; only the layout that issues the module's own call sequence (its column blocks split at ceil(N/2), its operand strides) is bitwise at every N. Opt-in `exact+<form>:prove` still serves an unvouched shape after a per-call-shape proof against `module=`.

policy.rule: FAST: the FASTEST measured row wins; TIES -> native (rows native | native:f32in of the sealed trimul_native payload): a challenger takes the word from native only with a win beyond noise in the same process (median <= 0.98 x native's and the [median +- IQR/2] intervals disjoint). BIG: the fastest NON-ESM row by the same rule -- the ESM-family rows (esm_v5_fwd, esm_v5_fwd:f32in, esm_v61, esm_shapes, esm_shapes:f32in, esm_k1ptr, esm_k1ptr:f32in) are EXCLUDED from big on every cell and column: their N^2-scaled intermediates carry a measured IN-MODEL memory cost across a trunk that the per-call peak metric does not capture (program_evidence). c_z 128 (c_hidden 128; every precision, bucket, direction, card and column): FAST and BIG never an ESM row either (the in-model ruling of the c_z-128 pin restored: a tier word at that width goes to an ESM row only with an in-model number; program_evidence) -- the fastest non-ESM row, ties -> native; the ESM rows stay selectable by ROW word with their numbers kept. EXACT untouched.

Eligible arms = tiers.fast rows (not the form rows) with a number in the run that admit statically at the cell on that stack.
